scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem treats the positive quadrant, zero additive forcing, and damping magnitude at most one. It excludes the source paper's chaotic parameter examples and negative initial coordinates. The critical separator is algebraic at the endpoint but is given by rigorous bounds at intermediate damping. Numerical checks are supporting evidence, not infinite-time proofs. Priority comparisons are nonexhaustive.
title: A sharp escape separatrix and three growth regimes in a planar rational map
